$comment: The one list of repositories that make up the AI Video Production ecosystem. install.sh / scripts/bootstrap.sh install exactly what is listed here, and docs/ecosystem/registry.json must name the same repositories (checked by scripts/tests/test_ecosystem_manifest.py). To add a Skill to the ecosystem, add it here. "optional": true components are installed only with --with-optional.

components.role: Orchestrator: plans a production and calls the Skills below
Execution engine: typed FFmpeg/ffprobe tools every delegating Skill runs on
Cut, trim, concat, fit, overlay
Gain, mix, normalize, dynamics, denoise
Colour correction, LUT, HDR to SDR
Title cards, lower thirds, overlays
Subtitle validation, SRT/WebVTT generation, burn-in
Thumbnail rendering
TTS, voice replacement, fitting translated lines to source timing, audio description
Upload and metadata for delivery platforms, platform delivery specs
Rule-based QC: PASS/WARN/FAIL/UNKNOWN
Observation only: measures facts about a media file
Speech to timestamped transcript (local faster-whisper)
Face, text (OCR) and object detection
Slide import, slide-change detection, slide text
Still-image editing with ImageMagick
Headless Blender: inspect, convert, optimize and render 3D assets (needs Blender installed)
Verifies AI-generated documents (scripts, captions, reports) and issues evidence-backed receipts
Screen recording of a task into a how-to guide and a SKILL.md
Blu-ray (BDMV) authoring: titles, chapters, menus, subtitles
DVD-Video (VIDEO_TS) authoring: titles, menus, subtitles
UDF disc image writer for DVD-Video and Blu-ray
Line-21 closed captions (CEA-608) into DVD MPEG-2 without re-encoding
DVD and Blu-ray authoring app (Mac): videos to disc images with menus, chapters, subtitles
